m.t: Proč vypadají tvoje vlasy tak nádherně?
m.e: Why does your hair look so fabulous?

m.e: No matter how dreadful things look.

m.e: And because The Others look like us, we can't trust anyone.

m.e: You know, sometimes things are just as they seem, detectives.

m.e: They do look awfully similar ... whatever they are.

m.e: Okay, you sure they look good?

m.e: They seem like pretty big players around here.

m.t: Tyhle perly vypadají, že jsou pravé.
m.e: These pearls look real.

m.e: This is why I tolerate the look of your feet!

m.e: He told the ship's doc that they looked like demons.

m.e: Inner organs look as they should.

m.e: Even though they look like twins, Carlos and Juan are only brothers.

m.e: - Well, those look good.

m.e: Not just with the presidency, but with my wife, with my girls.

m.e: Not only did your friend destroy everything we've been working towards, he also got away.
